item.text: {"piece_id":"01","ready":false,"issues":["01-c1 locator quotes do not support the stated Fusion import, material-assignment, target-mass, or two-drawing details.","01-c3 locator quotes omit the stated 100-task benchmark context and therefore do not fully support the claim.","01-c5 calls the RobotWorld result simulated and executable-checked without locator support for either condition.","01-c5 relies on an unverified automatic-transcript numerical claim; the supplied evidence does not independently verify the 63-of-84 figure.","The argument claims progress in finding CAD artifacts, but no Onshape search evidence or claim supports that development.","The limitation says the robotics evidence is simulated, but the cited podcast locator does not establish simulation."]}
